tags.name: Spend Controls
tags.description:
### Resource model
Spend controls can be configured at the workspace, group, or user level. `WorkspaceUsageLimit`, `GroupUsageLimit`, and `UserUsageLimit` expose the applicable monthly usage limits and current usage. `UserMonthlyUsageLimitStatus` returns one user's live current-month usage and effective monthly usage limit. `UsageLimitRequest` represents a user's request for a higher monthly usage limit, including the original and requested limits and its resolution status.

List endpoints use cursor envelopes with `data`, `has_more`, `cursor`, and `last_id`. User list `query` values perform a case-insensitive substring search across names and email addresses. To update a user starting from email, select the row whose `email` equals the requested address using a case-insensitive comparison, then use that row's stable `id` with `PATCH /manage/workspaces/{workspace_id}/usage_limits/users/{user_id}`. Each usage-limit entry contains `limit` and `type`.

### Base URL
`https://api.chatgpt.com/v1/usage`

### Endpoints
- `GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/usage_limits/workspace`
- `PATCH /workspaces/{workspace_id}/usage_limits/workspace`
- `GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/usage_limits/groups`
- `GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/usage_limits/groups/{group_id}`
- `PATCH /workspaces/{workspace_id}/usage_limits/groups/{group_id}`
- `GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/usage_limits/users`
- `GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/usage_limits/users/{user_id}`
- `PATCH /workspaces/{workspace_id}/usage_limits/users/{user_id}`
- `GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/usage_limits/users/{user_id}/monthly-usage`
- `GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/usage_limits/requests`
- `PATCH /workspaces/{workspace_id}/usage_limits/requests/{request_id}`

### Required Admin API key scope
- Read: `chatgpt.enterprise.usage_limit.read`
- Write: `chatgpt.enterprise.usage_limit.write`

### Resolution behavior
Usage-limit requests can be approved or denied while pending. Approval uses the user's requested limit by default; `approved_monthly_usage_limit` may set a different final limit.

### Error cases
Requests fail when the Admin API key is missing or invalid, lacks the required scope or workspace access, references a missing workspace or resource, uses an invalid cursor, is rate limited, or submits an invalid usage-limit rule or request resolution.

### Audit logging
Every endpoint emits a Compliance Logs Platform `AUDIT_LOG` event for the Admin API key request. The actions are `GET_WORKSPACE_USAGE_LIMIT`, `UPDATE_WORKSPACE_USAGE_LIMIT`, `LIST_GROUP_USAGE_LIMITS`, `GET_GROUP_USAGE_LIMIT`, `UPDATE_GROUP_USAGE_LIMIT`, `LIST_USER_USAGE_LIMITS`, `GET_USER_USAGE_LIMIT`, `GET_USER_MONTHLY_USAGE_LIMIT_STATUS`, `UPDATE_USER_USAGE_LIMIT`, `LIST_USAGE_LIMIT_REQUESTS`, and `UPDATE_USAGE_LIMIT_REQUEST`. Mutations also reuse the existing workspace-admin audit events for the underlying spend-control change.

tags.name: Workspace Usage Limits
tags.description:
### Resource model
`WorkspaceUsageLimit` contains stable `object` and `id` fields plus `default_user_monthly_usage_limit`, the workspace-default monthly limit inherited by users without a more specific group or user limit. Each usage-limit entry contains `limit` and `type`. Workspace-default updates accept only a finite `limited` limit, or `null` to clear the workspace default. The write endpoint applies the same default to both default and usage-based seats.

### Base URL
`https://api.chatgpt.com/v1/usage`

### Endpoints
- `GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/usage-limits/workspace`
- `PATCH /workspaces/{workspace_id}/usage-limits/workspace`

### Required Admin API key scope
- Read: `chatgpt.enterprise.usage_limit.read`
- Write: `chatgpt.enterprise.usage_limit.write`

### Error cases
Requests fail when the Admin API key is missing or invalid, is not an Admin API key, lacks the required scope, belongs to an organization that does not own the workspace, references a workspace without a tenant link, or submits an invalid usage-limit rule.

### Audit logging
`GET` and `PATCH` emit Compliance Logs Platform `AUDIT_LOG` events for the Admin API key request with actions `GET_WORKSPACE_USAGE_LIMIT` and `UPDATE_WORKSPACE_USAGE_LIMIT`. `PATCH` also reuses the existing workspace admin audit logger for the hard-cap mutation (`WORKSPACE_TOGGLE_FEATURE`).

tags.name: Group Usage Limits
tags.description:
### Resource model
`GroupUsageLimit` contains stable `object` and `id` fields plus group name, member count, and `default_user_monthly_usage_limit` inherited by members without a direct user override. `GroupUsageLimitList` is a cursor envelope with `data`, `has_more`, `cursor`, and `last_id`; list results are ordered by group ID. Each usage-limit entry contains `limit` and `type`.

### Base URL
`https://api.chatgpt.com/v1/usage`

### Endpoints
- `GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/usage-limits/groups`
- `GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/usage-limits/groups/{group_id}`
- `PATCH /workspaces/{workspace_id}/usage-limits/groups/{group_id}`

### Required Admin API key scope
- Read: `chatgpt.enterprise.usage_limit.read`
- Write: `chatgpt.enterprise.usage_limit.write`

### Error cases
Requests fail when the Admin API key is missing or invalid, is not an Admin API key, lacks the required scope, belongs to an organization that does not own the workspace, references a workspace without a tenant link, references a missing group, or submits an invalid usage-limit rule.

### Audit logging
`GET /groups`, `GET /groups/{group_id}`, and `PATCH /groups/{group_id}` emit Compliance Logs Platform `AUDIT_LOG` events for the Admin API key request with actions `LIST_GROUP_USAGE_LIMITS`, `GET_GROUP_USAGE_LIMIT`, and `UPDATE_GROUP_USAGE_LIMIT`. `PATCH` also reuses the existing workspace admin audit logger for the hard-cap mutation (`GROUP_EDIT`).

tags.name: User Usage Limits
tags.description:
### Resource model
`UserUsageLimit` contains stable `object` and `id` fields plus the workspace-scoped account user ID, current usage, direct override, effective monthly limit, and inherited limit source. `UserUsageLimitList` is a cursor envelope with `data`, `has_more`, `cursor`, and `last_id`; list results are ordered by auth user ID, `query` performs a case-insensitive substring search across names and email addresses, and a cursor must be reused with the same `query`. To update a user starting from email, select the row whose `email` equals the requested address using a case-insensitive comparison, then use that row's stable `id` with `PATCH /manage/workspaces/{workspace_id}/usage_limits/users/{user_id}`. Single-resource `GET` and `PATCH` return the `UserUsageLimit` resource directly, not inside the list envelope. `UserMonthlyUsageLimitStatus` returns the live current-month usage plus effective monthly limit directly for one user. Each usage-limit entry contains `limit` and `type`.

### Base URL
`https://api.chatgpt.com/v1/usage`

### Endpoints
- `GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/usage-limits/users`
- `GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/usage-limits/users/{user_id}`
- `PATCH /workspaces/{workspace_id}/usage-limits/users/{user_id}`
- `GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/usage-limits/users/{user_id}/monthly-usage`

### Required Admin API key scope
- Read: `chatgpt.enterprise.usage_limit.read`
- Write: `chatgpt.enterprise.usage_limit.write`

### Error cases
Requests fail when the Admin API key is missing or invalid, is not an Admin API key, lacks the required scope, belongs to an organization that does not own the workspace, references a workspace without a tenant link, references a missing user, uses an invalid cursor or mismatched cursor/query pair, is rate limited, or submits an invalid usage-limit rule.

### Audit logging
`GET /users`, `GET /users/{user_id}`, `PATCH /users/{user_id}`, and `GET /users/{user_id}/monthly-usage` emit Compliance Logs Platform `AUDIT_LOG` events for the Admin API key request with actions `LIST_USER_USAGE_LIMITS`, `GET_USER_USAGE_LIMIT`, `UPDATE_USER_USAGE_LIMIT`, and `GET_USER_MONTHLY_USAGE_LIMIT_STATUS`. `PATCH` also reuses the existing workspace admin audit logger for the hard-cap mutation (`USER_ROLE_UPDATED`).

tags.name: Usage Limit Requests
tags.description:
### Resource model
`UsageLimitRequest` represents one workspace user's request for a higher monthly hard cap. It contains stable `object` and `id` fields, requester identity, request status, justification, the original and requested usage limits, and resolution metadata. `UsageLimitRequestList` uses the standard cursor envelope with `data`, `has_more`, `cursor`, and `last_id`. `PATCH` returns the full updated request directly.

### Base URL
`https://api.chatgpt.com/v1/usage`

### Endpoints
- `GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/usage-limits/requests`
- `PATCH /workspaces/{workspace_id}/usage-limits/requests/{request_id}`

### Required Admin API key scope
- Read: `chatgpt.enterprise.usage_limit.read`
- Write: `chatgpt.enterprise.usage_limit.write`

### Resolution behavior
`PATCH` accepts only `approved` or `denied`. Approval uses the user's requested limit by default; `approved_usage_limit` may set a different final hard cap. Only pending requests can be resolved.

### Error cases
Requests fail when the Admin API key is missing or invalid, is not an Admin API key, lacks the required scope, belongs to an organization that does not own the workspace, references a workspace without a tenant link, references a missing or non-pending request, uses an invalid cursor, or submits an invalid approved usage limit.

### Audit logging
`GET /requests` and `PATCH /requests/{request_id}` emit Compliance Logs Platform `AUDIT_LOG` events for the Admin API key request with actions `LIST_USAGE_LIMIT_REQUESTS` and `UPDATE_USAGE_LIMIT_REQUEST`.

tags.name: Codex Enterprise Analytics
tags.description:
This API allows ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex administrators to pull daily Codex
adoption and code review metrics for a workspace. It is intended for dashboarding,
reporting, and trend analysis, with metrics aggregated by day and optional per-user
breakdowns where available. The endpoints return time-ordered pages with
cursor-based pagination.

## Authentication
Workspace owners and workspace admins can create a workspace-scoped Admin key in
the [OpenAI Admin Console](https://admin.openai.com/) under **Credentials > Admin
keys**. Select the workspace, choose **Restricted** permissions, and add the
`codex.enterprise.analytics.read` scope. Copy the secret immediately because it
is shown only once, store it securely, and send requests with
`Authorization: Bearer <admin_api_key>`. The base URL is
`https://api.chatgpt.com/v1/analytics/codex`.

## Finding your workspace ID
ChatGPT Admins and Codex Admins can open the ChatGPT Admin console at
https://chatgpt.com/admin and copy the org ID and Workspace ID from the workspace
settings page.

## Pagination and request parameters
- `start_time` and `end_time` define the reporting window in Unix seconds (end_time
  is exclusive).
- `limit` controls page size.
- `page` is the cursor token from a previous response's `next_page`.

Responses are ordered by `start_time` ascending and return a page envelope with
`object`, `data`, `has_more`, and `next_page`. When `has_more` is true, pass
`next_page` back as the `page` query parameter to fetch the next set of rows.
